name: Generic Identification
definition: Information related to a non-standardised identification, such as a proprietary party identification or account identification.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Name or number assigned by an entity to enable recognition of that entity, for example account identifier, identification assigned by a provider to identify its customers.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date at which the identification was issued.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date at which the identification expires.

IdentificationForContactPoint.name: Identification For Contact Point
IdentificationForContactPoint.definition: Contact point which uses a generic identification as identification.

IdentificationForAccount.name: Identification For Account
IdentificationForAccount.definition: Account Identification which uses a generic identification as proprietary identification.

Scheme.name: Scheme
Scheme.definition: Information regarding an enumerated code list and its owner.

IdentificationForSecuritiesCertificate.name: Identification For Securities Certificate
IdentificationForSecuritiesCertificate.definition: Securities certificate which uses a generic identification as certificate number.

IdentificationForLot.name: Identification For Lot
IdentificationForLot.definition: Lot breakdown which uses a generic identification as lot number.

IdentificationForCashProceedsIncome.name: Identification For Cash Proceeds Income
IdentificationForCashProceedsIncome.definition: Cash proceeds definition which uses a generic identification as type of income.

RelatedStatusReason.name: Related Status Reason
RelatedStatusReason.definition: Specifies the status reason for which a data source scheme is specified.

IdentificationForBankTransaction.name: Identification For Bank Transaction
IdentificationForBankTransaction.definition: Bank transaction which uses a generic identification as proprietary identification.

IdentificationForAccountCostReferencePat.name: Identification For Account Cost Reference Pattern
IdentificationForAccountCostReferencePat.definition: Account identification for which a cost reference pattern is provided.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account for which a type is specified

RelatedSystemIdentification.name: Related System Identification
RelatedSystemIdentification.definition: System identification which uses a generic identification.

IdentificationForInterestName.name: Identification For Interest Name
IdentificationForInterestName.definition: Interest which uses a generic identification as name.

RelatedCashAccountService.name: Related Cash Account Service
RelatedCashAccountService.definition: Cash account service identified in a generic way.

IdentificationForInvestmentFundClass.name: Identification For Investment Fund Class
IdentificationForInvestmentFundClass.definition: Investment fund class which uses a generic identification as fund classification.

IdentifiedLocation.name: Identified Location
IdentifiedLocation.definition: Location for which an identification is provided.

RelatedSecuritiesIdentification.name: Related Securities Identification
RelatedSecuritiesIdentification.definition: Securities identification for which generic identification elements and scheme are provided.

IdentifiedDocument.name: Identified Document
IdentifiedDocument.definition: Document for which an identification is provided.

RelatedPurchaseOrder.name: Related Purchase Order
RelatedPurchaseOrder.definition: Purchase order for which an identification is provided.

RelatedCertificate.name: Related Certificate
RelatedCertificate.definition: Related certificate against which all transactions in the scope of the regulatory requirements are registered.
